specs.summary: A group manager changes a group's name, description, rule, join policy, visibility, member-list visibility or whether it issues credentials.

specs.title: VTC Install Claim — Finish
specs.summary: Complete first-administrator enrolment under a DID the founder already controls — signed by that DID against its live document, carrying the founder's step-up approver's enrolment statement — and receive a setup-session token.

specs.title: VTC Install Claim — Passkey — Finish
specs.summary: Complete first-administrator enrolment with a passkey — submit the WebAuthn registration and one assertion proving possession of its key, derive the administrator's did:key from the credential's own Ed25519 or P-256 public key, and receive a setup-session token.

specs.title: VTC Install Claim — Passkey — Start
specs.summary: Begin claiming a fresh community with a passkey — exchange the install token for a WebAuthn registration challenge, from whose credential key — Ed25519 or P-256 — the first administrator's did:key will be derived.

specs.title: VTC Install Claim — Start
specs.summary: Begin claiming a fresh community under a DID the founder already controls — exchange the install token and its claim code for a challenge the founder's step-up approver will sign.

specs.title: VTC Invitations — Deliver
specs.summary: Deliver an issued invitation to the DID it admits — pushed to that DID as a credential offer, or returned as an offer small enough for a QR code — releasable only to that DID.

specs.title: VTC Invitations — Issue
specs.summary: Issue a single-use Invitation Credential (VIC) admitting a named DID to a Verifiable Trust Community, optionally granting a role and bounded by an expiry.

specs.title: VTC Invitations — List
specs.summary: Enumerate a Verifiable Trust Community's issued Invitation Credentials with their issuance and revocation state, without re-disclosing credential material.

specs.title: VTC Invitations — Revoke
specs.summary: Revoke an issued Invitation Credential by flipping its published status-list bit, reporting whether this call was the one that revoked it.

specs.title: VTC Join-Requests — Accept
specs.summary: An approved applicant completes membership by issuing the reciprocal credential back to the community.

specs.title: VTC Join-Requests — Approve
specs.summary: An administrator approves a pending join request, admitting the applicant to the community.

specs.title: VTC Join-Requests — Decide
specs.summary: An administrator decides a pending join request — approving admits the applicant as a member, rejecting refuses them — optionally recording a reason.

specs.title: VTC Join-Requests — List
specs.summary: List a community's join requests, optionally filtered by status, newest paged.

specs.title: VTC Join-Requests — Manifest
specs.summary: Discover a community's join criteria before applying — each way in, what it requires, whether it admits automatically or is reviewed, a digest naming its version — and what the community's member directory would disclose, and to whom.

specs.title: VTC Join Requests — Query
specs.summary: An administrator asks the community to open a credential exchange with a prospective member — issue a presentation challenge, build the credential-exchange/query for a registered Accepts criterion, and deliver it.

specs.title: VTC Join-Requests — Reject
specs.summary: An administrator rejects a pending join request, optionally recording a reason.

specs.title: VTC Join-Requests — Show
specs.summary: Fetch one join request by id, including the applicant's presentation and the recorded policy verdict.

specs.title: VTC Join-Requests — Status
specs.summary: An applicant polls the state of their pending join request, learning what more is needed if deferred, and may ask for an approved request's credentials to be sent again.

specs.title: VTC Join-Requests — Submit
specs.summary: An applicant submits a request to join a Verifiable Trust Community under one of its published join criteria, presenting what that criterion requires; the community decides it as the criterion's admission mode states.

specs.title: VTC Join Requests — Submit Receipt
specs.summary: A community's acknowledgement that an applicant's join request was accepted for processing, naming the request id the applicant polls on.

specs.title: VTC Join-Requests — Supplement
specs.summary: An applicant answers a community's request for more evidence by re-presenting against their existing join request, rather than opening a second one.

specs.title: VTC Join Requests — Vetting — Show
specs.summary: An administrator reads the identity-vetting facts one join request was decided on — every statement it carried, which counted and why not, and which have been withdrawn since.

specs.title: VTC Join-Requests — Wallet Session Start
specs.summary: An applicant opens a short-lived OpenID4VP presentation session for one join criterion, and receives the wallet URI a swiyu or EUDI wallet scans to present credentials as evidence for the applicant's join.

specs.title: VTC Join-Requests — Wallet Session Status
specs.summary: An applicant reads the state of a wallet presentation session they opened, and once a wallet has answered, whether the presentation satisfied the criterion, whose key held the credentials and which credentials they were — never their claim values.

specs.title: VTC Join-Requests — Withdraw
specs.summary: An applicant withdraws their own pending or deferred join request, closing it and releasing their ability to apply again.

specs.title: VTC Members — Admin-Remove
specs.summary: An administrator removes a member from the community, choosing the record disposition and recording a reason.

specs.title: VTC Members — Admit
specs.summary: An administrator admits a DID as a member without a join request: the access-control entry, the member record and the membership credentials a completed join leaves behind, at a community role the administrator names, decided by the community's admission policy.

specs.title: VTC Members — Authority-Reduced Notice
specs.summary: A community tells a subject that an administrator reduced their administrative authority — on whose authority, when, why, and whether anyone else agreed.

specs.title: VTC Members — Authority-Reduction-Pending Notice
specs.summary: A community tells a subject that a reduction of their administrative authority has been requested and is cooling off — by whom, why, and when it lands unless its requester cancels it — so the subject learns of it before it takes effect.

specs.title: VTC Members — Credentials
specs.summary: Fetch the membership-pair credential bodies a community holds for one member — the community-issued grant, the member-issued acknowledgement, and the role endorsement.

specs.title: VTC Members — List
specs.summary: List a Verifiable Trust Community's members, newest paged, each joined with its ACL role, optionally filtered by role.

specs.title: VTC Members — Make-Membership
specs.summary: An administrator gives an access-control entry with no member record — typically the bootstrap administrator — the member record and membership credentials a join would have given it, at the role it already holds.

specs.title: VTC Members Personhood — Assert
specs.summary: A member asserts personhood by presenting a Verifiable Presentation that satisfies the community's personhood policy, with the outcome evidence of any Verifiable Witness Credential it presents; re-issues their credentials with the personhood flag set.

specs.title: VTC Members Personhood — Challenge
specs.summary: Open a personhood-assertion ceremony for a member — return the single-use challenge to embed in the assertion presentation.

specs.title: VTC Members Personhood — Revoke
specs.summary: An administrator revokes a member's personhood, re-issuing their credentials with the personhood flag cleared.

specs.title: VTC Members — Purge
specs.summary: Irreversibly delete a removed member's tombstone and residual records from a Verifiable Trust Community, refusing when it would orphan the last administrator.

specs.title: VTC Members — Registry Consent
specs.summary: A member grants or withdraws their own consent to the community publishing their membership in its trust registry, without leaving and rejoining.

specs.title: VTC Members — Removal Notice
specs.summary: A community tells a member it removed them — on whose authority, when, and why — so the most consequential decision a community makes is not the one it delivers in silence.

specs.title: VTC Members — Removed
specs.summary: Enumerate the tombstones of members who have left a Verifiable Trust Community, with when they left and their published revocation slot.

specs.title: VTC Members — Renew
specs.summary: A member renews their community membership, re-issuing their membership and role credentials.

specs.title: VTC Members — Request VMC
specs.summary: A community asks one of its members to issue and return a reciprocal Membership Credential naming the community as subject.

specs.title: VTC Members — Role Set
specs.summary: An administrator moves a subject's community role — member, moderator, issuer, admin or a custom role — with a compare-and-swap on the current role, carrying the administrative authority the role implies and re-issuing the role credential.

specs.title: VTC Members — Rotate
specs.summary: Complete a member DID rotation by proving control of the old and new keys; re-issues credentials to the new DID.

specs.title: VTC Members — Rotate Challenge
specs.summary: Open a DID-rotation ceremony for the calling member and return the challenge bytes to sign with the old and new keys.

specs.title: VTC Members — Self-Remove
specs.summary: A member removes themselves from a Verifiable Trust Community, choosing how their record is disposed of.

specs.title: VTC Members — Self-Remove Receipt
specs.summary: A community's asynchronous acknowledgement that a member's own departure request has been carried out, naming how their published record was dispositioned.

specs.title: VTC Members — Show
specs.summary: Fetch one Verifiable Trust Community member by DID, joined with its ACL role. The read-one companion to vtc/members/list.

specs.title: VTC Members — Solicit VMC
specs.summary: Ask the community to request a reciprocal Membership Credential from one of its members; the community dispatches the request and the member answers asynchronously.

specs.title: VTC Members — Step-up Passkey Notice
specs.summary: The VTC tells a member, unprompted, that a step-up passkey was enrolled for them or revoked from them — what happened, which credential, who acted and when — so a change made by someone else, such as an administrator, is never silent.

specs.title: VTC Members — Update
specs.summary: Update a community member's role or non-credential metadata (consent withdrawal, departure preference, extensions); refuses promotion to admin and never grants registry consent.

specs.title: VTC Members — Deliver VMC
specs.summary: A member delivers their issued Membership Credential to the community, which stores it and returns a receipt naming the stored credential.

specs.title: VTC Networks — Deliver
specs.summary: A Verifiable Trust Network delivers a signed broadcast envelope to the community's group registered for one of its roles, and the community passes it on to the group's members.

specs.title: VTC Networks — Evidence
specs.summary: A member asks the community for the credentials that link a group they belong to up to a Verifiable Trust Network, which a network asks for before it admits them to a room.

specs.title: VTC Networks — Groups — Register
specs.summary: An administrator registers one of the community's groups to serve a role in a Verifiable Trust Network the community belongs to, such as the network's admins.

specs.title: VTC Networks — Join
specs.summary: An administrator accepts a Verifiable Trust Network's listing of the community: the community registers its groups for the network's required roles and signs the membership acknowledgement.

specs.title: VTC Networks — Leave
specs.summary: An administrator withdraws the community from a Verifiable Trust Network by repudiating the network's membership grant.

specs.title: VTC Networks — List
specs.summary: An administrator lists the Verifiable Trust Networks the community belongs to, has repudiated or has left.

specs.title: VTC Networks — Notice
specs.summary: The community passes a Verifiable Trust Network's broadcast on to a member of the group registered for its role, carrying the network's signed envelope unchanged.

specs.title: VTC Networks — Preview
specs.summary: An administrator reads a Verifiable Trust Network before joining it: its profile, the roles it requires a group for, and whether it lists the community.

specs.title: VTC Networks — Repudiate
specs.summary: An administrator rejects a Verifiable Trust Network's listing of the community, which the network must then publish beside the listing.

specs.title: VTC Networks — Show
specs.summary: An administrator reads one of the community's network memberships: its state, the credentials that evidence it, and the groups registered for the network's roles.

specs.title: VTC Notifications — List
specs.summary: An administrator lists the notifications the community holds as their addressee — filtered by kind or holder — with whether each may be relayed, what a relay of it discloses, and the relay decisions already made.

specs.title: VTC Notifications — Relay
specs.summary: An administrator, shown what it discloses, decides that the community relays a notification it received to its members — all, one group's or one role's — and the community relays the originator's document unchanged to each.

specs.title: VTC Notifications — Show
specs.summary: An administrator reads one notification the community holds as its addressee, with the document that delivered it exactly as received, what a relay of it discloses, and the relay decisions made — the read that precedes a relay decision.

specs.title: VTC OpenID4VP — Verifier Identities List
specs.summary: An administrator reads the OpenID4VP verifier identities the community presents to swiyu and EUDI wallets — each one's client identifier, key custody, access certificate and verifier attestations with their expiry — and what, if anything, stops each from serving a wallet.

specs.title: VTC Operator — Offline Write (record type)
specs.summary: A record type, never sent — it describes an access-control change an operator made offline on a community's host, so an acknowledge action and the audit trail have a Type URI to name it by.

specs.title: VTC Policies — Test
specs.summary: Evaluate a stored policy module against caller-supplied input without activating it, returning the raw result of the queried rule.

specs.title: VTC Recognition — Check
specs.summary: Ask whether a Verifiable Trust Community recognises a foreign DID, and whether the trust registry backing that answer is actually configured.

specs.title: VTC Registry — Diagnostics
specs.summary: Report the registry-reconciler's health — queue depth, RTBF-batched and failed counts, oldest-pending age, and last success/failure timestamps.

specs.title: VTC Registry Records — List
specs.summary: Enumerate the trust records backing a community's recognition graph — either as the trust registry holds them, or as the community believes it published them — so the two can be compared.

specs.title: VTC Registry Sync Jobs — Discard
specs.summary: Delete an abandoned trust-registry reconciliation job without dispatching it, accepting that the member's registry record stays as it is.

specs.title: VTC Registry Sync Jobs — List
specs.summary: Enumerate a Verifiable Trust Community's trust-registry reconciliation queue, so an operator can see which membership changes have not reached the registry and why.

specs.title: VTC Registry Sync Jobs — Retry
specs.summary: Requeue a trust-registry reconciliation job — one the community's reconciler has abandoned, or one waiting out a retry backoff — so a membership change that has not reached the registry is dispatched on the reconciler's next pass.

specs.title: VTC Relationships — Graph
specs.summary: Return a Verifiable Trust Community's published relationship credentials as a node-and-edge graph of who has vouched for whom.

specs.title: VTC Relationships — List
specs.summary: List the Verifiable Relationship Credentials published about a community member.

specs.title: VTC Relationships — Publish
specs.summary: A member publishes a Verifiable Relationship Credential asserting a relationship to another community member.

specs.title: VTC Relationships — Request
specs.summary: A member asks another member to issue them a Verifiable Relationship Credential, and receives the signed VRC in the response.

specs.title: VTC Relationships — Restore
specs.summary: The issuer of a suspended relationship edge — or a moderating administrator — reverses the suspension.

specs.title: VTC Relationships — Revoke
specs.summary: The issuer revokes a Verifiable Relationship Credential they previously published — including one issued under a pairwise relationship DID, by proving control of it — or an administrator revokes it for moderation.

specs.title: VTC Relationships — Suspend
specs.summary: The issuer of a published relationship edge — or a moderating administrator — makes it temporarily ineffective without withdrawing it, leaving a supported way back.

specs.title: VTC Roles — Define
specs.summary: A community administrator creates a custom administrative role at a Verifiable Trust Community, or replaces one — a named capability ceiling and approve ceiling that AclEntry 0.2 entries can then hold.

specs.title: VTC Roles — Delete
specs.summary: A community administrator deletes a custom administrative role from a Verifiable Trust Community — refused for built-in roles and for any role an ACL entry still holds.

specs.title: VTC Roles — List
specs.summary: A querying party asks a Verifiable Trust Community for its administrative role vocabulary — every built-in and custom role, with each role's capability ceiling and approve ceiling.

specs.title: VTC Roles — Show
specs.summary: A querying party fetches one administrative role of a Verifiable Trust Community by name — its capability ceiling, approve ceiling and, optionally, how many entries hold it.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Community — Archive
specs.summary: An administrator archives a data room the community owns: it admits no one and its host accepts no writes; members keep reading (readOnly) or have every credential withdrawn at the host until it is reopened (noAccess). The content is kept.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Community — Create
specs.summary: An administrator creates a data room the community itself owns, with a label and a description: the community's VTA mints its identity and holds its keys, the community hosts it, and the label and description are sealed into the room as its profile for members.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Community — Get
specs.summary: An administrator reads one data room the community itself owns: its state — active, archived, scheduled for removal, being purged or removed — host record, label, description, tags, storage config, member counts and when the community's own authority over it expires.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Community — List
specs.summary: An administrator lists the data rooms the community itself owns, with each room's state in its owner's lifecycle, label, description, tags, tier and how many members it has admitted, offered or suspended; removed rooms only when asked for.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Community — Members — Add
specs.summary: An administrator admits a community member to a data room the community owns: the community's VTA issues the room's credentials to them, and the community keeps them as an offer the member collects.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Community — Members — List
specs.summary: An administrator lists who the community has admitted to, offered admission to, suspended from or removed from a data room it owns — a removed room's too.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Community — Members — Remove
specs.summary: An administrator removes a member from a data room the community owns: the room's host refuses the member's credentials from that moment, on a sealed tier the room advances to an epoch sealed to everyone else, and any open offer is withdrawn.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Community — Removal — Cancel
specs.summary: An administrator cancels the scheduled removal of a data room the community owns, before its grace period ends: the room returns to archived with noAccess, its content intact, and nothing is purged.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Community — Remove
specs.summary: An administrator removes an archived data room the community owns: every credential is withdrawn at its host, and after a grace period — or at once — its content is purged from the host and from storage, its identity retired, and only a record that it existed is kept.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Community — Unarchive
specs.summary: An administrator reopens an archived data room the community owns: its host accepts its members' writes again, and members whose credentials a noAccess archival withdrew have the room re-issue them, with the actions and expiry they had.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Community — Update
specs.summary: An administrator renames a data room the community itself owns, or changes its description or tags; a new label or description is re-sealed into the room as its profile, so its members — not only those it is offered to — can tell what it is.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Get
specs.summary: A room-hosting administrator reads one hosted data room in detail — its storage config, effective limits and their source, usage and orphaned blobs — everything a host holds about a room's files and nothing derived from them.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Limits — Set
specs.summary: A room-hosting administrator overrides how much one hosted data room may store — for the room, for its members by default, or for one named member — or clears an override, with a reason that is audited.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — List
specs.summary: A community administrator pages through the data rooms the community hosts — owner, tier, epoch and lifecycle state of each — which is everything a host holds about a room and nothing derived from its contents.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Memberships — List
specs.summary: A member reads the community's own record of every room it has offered them — offered, admitted, suspended or removed — and where each room stands, active, read-only, closed or going away, so that every surface they reach the community from shows the same rooms in the same state.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Offers — Accept
specs.summary: A member accepts an admission to a community-owned data room; on a sealed tier the community's VTA adds their KeyPackage to the room's group and the member receives the Welcome for their own key holder.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Offers — List
specs.summary: A member lists the admissions to community-owned data rooms the community has offered them — each room's label and what it is for — and the renewals of admissions they hold, with the credentials to store in their own key holder.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Storage — Assign
specs.summary: A room-hosting administrator points one hosted data room at another storage config, so its new uploads go there; files it already holds stay where they are and keep working.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Storage — Migrate
specs.summary: A room-hosting administrator moves a hosted data room's existing files onto the storage config it is now assigned to — copy, verify against the committed digest, switch, then delete the old copy — resumably and without any key.

specs.title: VTC Rooms — Usage
specs.summary: A room-hosting administrator reports how much the community's hosted data rooms store and serve — grouped by room, member, storage config or day, over a date range of up to 400 days — in sizes and counts only.

specs.title: VTC Schemas — Accepts — Delete
specs.summary: An administrator removes an Accepts criterion, so the join manifest stops publishing it and no new ceremony decides against it.

specs.title: VTC Schemas — Accepts — List
specs.summary: An administrator pages through the community's Accepts criteria — the evidence rules its ceremonies decide against.

specs.title: VTC Schemas — Accepts — Register
specs.summary: An administrator registers an Accepts criterion — one way into the community, stating what it requires (credentials, vetting, an invitation, or nothing) and whether meeting it admits automatically or is reviewed.

specs.title: VTC Schemas — Accepts — Show
specs.summary: An administrator fetches one Accepts criterion by id.

specs.title: VTC Schemas — Delete
specs.summary: An administrator removes a credential type from the community's schema registry, so it is no longer issued, or no longer accepted as evidence.

specs.title: VTC Schemas — List
specs.summary: An administrator pages through the community's schema registry — the credential types it issues and accepts — without their schema bodies.

specs.title: VTC Schemas — Register
specs.summary: An administrator registers a credential type the community issues or accepts, optionally binding it to a DTG catalog type and a JSON Schema its credentials must conform to.

specs.title: VTC Schemas — Show
specs.summary: An administrator fetches one registered credential type, including the JSON Schema its credentials are validated against.

specs.title: VTC Storage — Configs — Create
specs.summary: A room-hosting administrator adds a storage config — a named local, S3, GCS or Walrus backend and how the community authenticates to it — that data rooms can then be assigned to. Parked for another administrator's consent.

specs.title: VTC Storage — Configs — Get
specs.summary: A room-hosting administrator reads one storage config — its settings, how it authenticates, the rooms assigned to it, what it holds against its capacity and its health — and never a credential.

specs.title: VTC Storage — Configs — List
specs.summary: A room-hosting administrator pages through the community's storage configs — the named backends its data rooms' files are kept on — with what each holds, its credential state and its health, and never a credential.

specs.title: VTC Storage — Configs — Probe
specs.summary: A room-hosting administrator checks that a storage config works — authenticate, then put, read back and delete a canary object under a test prefix with the config's own credentials — and gets each step's result with the backend's error verbatim.

specs.title: VTC Storage — Configs — Retire
specs.summary: A room-hosting administrator retires a storage config with no rooms assigned and no migration onto it — it accepts no new rooms or uploads, keeps serving the files it holds while they are migrated off, and is never deleted while a blob names it. Parked for consent.

specs.title: VTC Storage — Configs — Update
specs.summary: A room-hosting administrator changes a storage config's label, capacity, default flag, authentication or the settings that do not locate stored files. Its kind and location are fixed while files live there. Parked for another administrator's consent.

specs.title: VTC Storage — Credentials — Set
specs.summary: The discouraged fallback for a community with no VTA account — a room-hosting administrator stores a storage config's long-lived credential, sealed in their browser to the community and never readable again. Parked for consent.

specs.title: VTC Vetting — Auto-Grant — Show
specs.summary: An administrator reads whether the community names vetters automatically, how often the sweep runs, how long its grants last, and what the last sweep did.

specs.title: VTC Vetting — Auto-Grant — Update
specs.summary: An administrator turns the automatic vetter-grant sweep on or off and sets its interval and the validity of the grants it issues.

specs.title: VTC Vetting — Hidden — Publish
specs.summary: An administrator turns on hidden-vetter admission for one criterion, or rotates its live labels and events, and reads back what the community now stores and now publishes.

specs.title: VTC Vetting — Hidden — Show
specs.summary: An administrator reads one criterion's stored hidden-vetting configuration, what it publishes, and how many vetters and event volunteers it has — counts only, never who.

specs.title: VTC Vetting — Hidden — Withdraw
specs.summary: An administrator turns hidden-vetter admission off for one criterion, leaving its named vetting unchanged, and reads back the criterion's requirements digest after the change.

specs.title: VTC — Vetting PCS Challenge
specs.summary: An applicant asks a community for the single-use challenge its hidden-vetting proof must be bound to, so that a proof counted once cannot be submitted again.

specs.title: VTC Vetting — Revocations — List
specs.summary: An administrator pages through the identity-vetting statements vetters have withdrawn, and sees which current members were admitted on one.

specs.title: VTC Vetting — Revoke Statement
specs.summary: A vetter withdraws a Vetting Statement it issued by telling the community that relies on it. From then on the statement does not count, and the community records that it was withdrawn.

specs.title: VTC — Vetting Event Mode
specs.summary: A vetter asks to vet at a named event at one of the community's published rates, and the community answers where that request stands — never whether the vetter granted it to themselves.

specs.title: VTC Vetting — Grant Vetter Role
specs.summary: A community administrator makes a member a vetter. The community issues the member a revocable Verifiable Authority Credential conferring the role:vetter action at the community, and a member who already holds a live grant gets it back unchanged.

specs.title: VTC Vetting — Vetter Grants — List
specs.summary: An administrator pages through every vetter grant the community has made — live, expired and revoked, automatic and manual — with each vetter's profile summary.

specs.title: VTC Vetting — List Vetters
specs.summary: Find a community's listed vetters by language, location, method or event. Only vetters who chose to be listed and hold a live grant appear, and only with what they published.

specs.title: VTC — Vetting PCS Binding — Reset
specs.summary: A community administrator resets a vetter's hidden-vetting identifier binding after the key behind it is lost. The community accepts a new identifier from that member only once no label the old one enrolled under is still live, so the member is never counted twice.

specs.title: VTC — Vetting PCS Binding — Show
specs.summary: A member asks its community which hidden-vetting identifier it is bound to, so its client can recover the matching key — or learn that an administrator's reset is pending and when a new key will be accepted.

specs.title: VTC — Vetting PCS Root Credential
specs.summary: A vetter asks its community to blind-sign the class credential for a vetting period, so it can later attest to applicants without the community learning which vetter attested.

specs.title: VTC — Vetting PCS Tokens
specs.summary: A vetter draws its scheduled tick of attestation tokens from the community, unconditionally and at a published rate, so that anonymous attestations stay rate-limited without anyone learning who has been busy.

specs.title: VTC Vetting — Vetter Profile
specs.summary: A vetter publishes, replaces or unlists the profile applicants use to find them — languages, a coarse location, methods, accepted documentation and upcoming events. The community keeps it only while the vetter is an active member with a vetter grant.

specs.title: VTC Vetting — Resend Vetter Grant
specs.summary: A vetter asks the community to deliver their live vetter role credential again, or an administrator does the same on a named member's behalf. Nothing new is issued.

specs.title: VTC Vetting — Show Vetter
specs.summary: Ask a community about one vetter by DID, and learn whether their grant is live, revoked, expired, or was never made.

specs.title: VTC Website — Deploy
specs.summary: An administrator publishes a staged, verified site bundle — replacing the live site, or creating a new generation in managed mode.

specs.title: VTC Website — File Delete
specs.summary: Delete a single file from a community's website root.

specs.title: VTC Website — Files List
specs.summary: List the files served by a community's website, paged, excluding hidden and blocklisted files.

specs.title: VTC Website — Files — Show
specs.summary: An administrator reads one website file's bytes, by range, with its content hash and type — so a file of any size can be read one bounded document at a time.

specs.title: VTC Website — Generations List
specs.summary: List a managed-mode website's deploy generations, marking the current one.

specs.title: VTC Website — Rollback
specs.summary: Roll a managed-mode website back to a past deploy generation by flipping the current pointer.

specs.title: VTC Website — Upload — Abort
specs.summary: Cancel an open or staged website upload and discard its bytes.

specs.title: VTC Website — Upload — Begin
specs.summary: An administrator opens an upload of one website file or a whole-site bundle, committing to its size, its SHA-256 and the digest of every chunk before any byte moves.

specs.title: VTC Website — Upload — Chunk
specs.summary: Send one chunk of an open website upload by index, checked on arrival against the digest committed for that index.

specs.title: VTC Website — Upload — Commit
specs.summary: Complete a website upload — reassemble it, check it against the SHA-256 committed at begin, and write the file into the site, or stage the bundle for deploy.

specs.title: VTN Audit — List
specs.summary: An administrator reads the network's audit trail: every change to its entries, when, to what state, by whom and why.

specs.title: VTN Broadcasts — List
specs.summary: An administrator reads the broadcasts the network sent or relayed, newest first, with their receipts.

specs.title: VTN Broadcasts — Send
specs.summary: An administrator sends a message to a role: the network signs it and delivers it to every current member's group for that role, network groups relay it further, and receipts come back.

specs.title: VTN Broadcasts — Show
specs.summary: An administrator reads one broadcast record by message id, with its receipts as they stand.

specs.title: VTN Directory — Federated Search
specs.summary: Search a network's published set and, through the signed indexes of its acknowledged member networks, theirs in turn, with each result's path and each hop's own entry state.

specs.title: VTN Directory — Search
specs.summary: Search the communities and networks a network publishes, each result stating whether it is a member, as far as the network's directory visibility admits the caller.

specs.title: VTN Directory — Summary
specs.summary: Counts of the communities and networks a network publishes, and how many are members, shown to anyone when the network shows its counts publicly.

specs.title: VTN Entries — Show
specs.summary: Read one listed party's published entry in a network, with the credentials a verifier needs and whether the party has acknowledged.

specs.title: VTN Graph — Member Network
specs.summary: Expand one acknowledged member network into its own trust graph, read from that network's verified signed index.

specs.title: VTN Graph — Show
specs.summary: A network's trust graph: the network and the parties it publishes as nodes, every credential between them as an edge with its status, as far as the network's directory visibility admits the caller.

specs.title: VTN Groups — List
specs.summary: An administrator lists the groups members have registered to serve the network's roles, each with the signed exchange that registered it.

specs.title: VTN Groups — Register
specs.summary: A listed party or member registers one of its groups to serve a network role; the network accepts it with a revocable groupRegistered credential bound to the signed request.

specs.title: VTN Listings — Create
specs.summary: An administrator lists a community or network: the network signs a listing credential and offers an unsigned membership grant, and the entry starts `listed`, which is never membership.

specs.title: VTN Listings — List
specs.summary: An administrator lists every entry the network holds, in the administrators' view: its credentials, offer and full lifecycle history, removed and departed entries included.

specs.title: VTN Listings — Reinstate
specs.summary: An administrator lifts a member's suspension: the network clears the grant's suspension bit and the entry is a member again.

specs.title: VTN Listings — Remove
specs.summary: An administrator removes an entry: the network revokes every credential it issued for it and drops its registered groups, ending the listing and any membership.

specs.title: VTN Listings — Show
specs.summary: An administrator reads one entry the network holds, in the administrators' view, whatever its state.

specs.title: VTN Listings — Suspend
specs.summary: An administrator suspends a member: the network marks its membership grant suspended in its status list, and the member stops receiving broadcasts until reinstated.

specs.title: VTN Listings — Update
specs.summary: An administrator edits the label and directory profile of an entry; no credential is reissued and the entry's state does not change.

specs.title: VTN Membership — Acknowledge
specs.summary: A listed party acknowledges a network's membership offer, and the network signs the grant it binds: the party becomes a member.

specs.title: VTN Membership — Offer
specs.summary: A listed party fetches the network's unsigned membership grant, so it can acknowledge it.

specs.title: VTN Membership — Repudiate
specs.summary: A listed party repudiates its listing, or a member departs by repudiating its grant.

specs.title: VTN Memberships — Groups — Add
specs.summary: An administrator registers this network's network group for one of its roles to serve a role at a parent network it is a member of, replacing any group registered for that parent role.

specs.title: VTN Memberships — Join
specs.summary: An administrator accepts a parent network's listing of this network: the network registers its network groups for the parent's roles and acknowledges the parent's membership offer, signing as itself.

specs.title: VTN Memberships — Leave
specs.summary: An administrator withdraws this network from a parent network: the network repudiates the parent's membership grant, signing as itself.

specs.title: VTN Memberships — List
specs.summary: An administrator lists the parent networks this network belongs to, has repudiated the listing of, or has left.

specs.title: VTN Memberships — Repudiate
specs.summary: An administrator rejects a parent network's listing of this network: the network signs a repudiation of the listing as itself, which the parent must publish beside it.

specs.title: VTN Outbox — List
specs.summary: An administrator reads the broadcast deliveries waiting to be retried, with their attempts, next attempt, expiry and last error.

specs.title: VTN Outbox — Retry
specs.summary: An administrator has the network retry every queued broadcast delivery now, without waiting for its backoff; the answer says how many were attempted.

specs.title: VTN Registry — Check
specs.summary: Ask a network to ask its trust registry whether a party is published as its member, and to return the registry's own signed answer.

specs.title: VTN Registry — Status
specs.summary: An administrator reads how the network's membership stands in its trust registry: the writer, the last reconcile, and every record compared with what the entries project.

specs.title: VTN Relay — Deliver
specs.summary: A parent network delivers a signed broadcast envelope to this network's group for a role, and this network relays it on to its own groups.

specs.title: VTN Roles — List
specs.summary: List the roles a network defines, and which of them a party must register a group for before it can become a member.

specs.title: VTN Rooms — List
specs.summary: List the rooms a network opens, and the role whose groups' members may enter each.

specs.title: VTN Rooms — Pass
specs.summary: A person presents their membership credential and the chain of group registrations up to the network, and receives a short-lived pass to a room.

specs.title: WebVH — Sync Batch
specs.summary: A source — a did:webvh control plane — replicates many slots' complete state to a replica in one document, as a resync after the replica (re-)registers, with a per-entry result.

specs.title: WebVH — Sync Delete
specs.summary: A source — a did:webvh control plane — tells a replica it drives, a hosting server or a watcher, that a slot no longer exists, and the replica stops serving it and removes its content.

specs.title: WebVH — Sync Update
specs.summary: A source — a did:webvh control plane — replicates one slot's complete current log, witness proofs and disabled state to a replica it drives, a hosting server or a watcher, which verifies the history before serving it.

specs.title: WebVH — Witness Key Create
specs.summary: An administrator has a did:webvh witness service generate a new witness identity — a key and the DID it controls — that DID logs can then name as a witness.

specs.title: WebVH — Witness Key Delete
specs.summary: An administrator has a did:webvh witness service destroy one witness identity's key; every DID log that names it can no longer obtain its proofs.

specs.title: WebVH — Witness Key List
specs.summary: An administrator lists the witness identities a did:webvh witness service holds — each one's DID, label, creation time and how many proofs it has signed. Never key material.

specs.title: WebVH — Witness Publish
specs.summary: A did:webvh owner publishes a witness-signed proof over a log entry so the hosting service can append it to the DID's permanent witness file.

specs.title: WebVH — Witness Sign
specs.summary: A requester asks a did:webvh witness service to witness one log entry; the witness verifies the log up to that entry and that it is named as a witness there, and only then returns its signed proof over the entry's versionId.

specs.title: Witness — Session
specs.summary: Opens one participating party's witness session as its own exchange, nested in a relationship exchange via parentThreadId. The witness's response issues the session challenge; this document's id is the value that party's Verifiable Witness Credential later carries as taskContext.

specs.title: Witness — Session Submit
specs.summary: A participating party submits its presentation, and optionally a member presentation, bound to its session challenge; the witness's mandatory response delivers the Verifiable Witness Credential and its digest — the outcome evidence a VWC presentation must ship.

ceremonies.title: In-person mutual attestation
ceremonies.summary: Two people meet, confirm each other, and each issues the other a credential. No third party, no ordering, no network — and the credentials may move long afterwards.

ceremonies.title: Identity vetting
ceremonies.summary: One vetter checks one applicant's identity for one community: the applicant asks, the two meet in a session, and the vetter issues a Vetting Statement or declines. An applicant runs one enactment per vetter.

ceremonies.title: VTC Member Onboarding
ceremonies.summary: Admit a member to a Verifiable Trust Community: application, decision, and the reciprocal membership credential that closes the bidirectional edge.
